description: installation of plant equipment at roof-level
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>The recommendations of the Sound Planning Noise Report and the proposed mitigation strategies shall be implemented in full and retained thereafter.<br><br>Reason: To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers.&nbsp;</p>

<p>A post-installation noise assessment report that demonstrates the noise levels from the 4 condensing units, hereby approved, and the existing extract plant machinery when running simultaneously shall be 10dB(A) or more below the background noise level when measured at 1m from any nearby noise-sensitive premises at any time. </p><p>The assessment of the expected noise levels shall be carried out by a suitably qualified (IOA accredited) and experienced acoustic consultant, in accordance with BS 4142:2014+A1:2019 ‘Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound,’ and any mitigation measures necessary to achieve the above required noise levels shall be submitted to the local planning authority in writing for approval within 2 months of installation.&nbsp;</p><p>REASON: To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers and the surrounding area.</p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt;"><font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 13.3333px; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Any plant shall be installed, together with any associated ancillary equipment, so as to prevent the transmission of noise and vibration into neighbouring premises. The rated noise level from all plant and ancillary equipment shall not increase the existing background noise level (10dB below) when measured 1m external from the nearest residential or noise-sensitive premises. </span></font></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt;"><font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 13.3333px; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The plant shall thereafter be installed and maintained in accordance with the approved details.</span></font></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt;"><font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 13.3333px; white-space-collapse: preserve;"><br></span></font></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt;"><font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 13.3333px; white-space-collapse: preserve;">REASON: To protect the amenities of the residents of the surrounding area.</span></font></p>
